columns.validationmsg: 'Flat Discount should be greater equal zero'
columns.name: flatdisc

columns.validationmsg: 'Miscellaneous Charges should be greater equal zero'
columns.name: misccharges

table.retrieve:
SELECT 
	saleledger.saleinvcode,   
	saleledger.flatdisc,   
	saleledger.misccharges,   
	saleledger.salestax,   
	saleledger.discperc,
	Icode = 0, 
	itemtotalval=space(30),
	Stock = 0.0000,
	TotalStock = 0.0000,
	Total = 0.00,
	purdiscperc = 0.00,
	InvGSTPerc1= saleledger.Invgstperc1,
	avgprice=0.000,
	rpp=0.00,
	rppmargin=0.00,
	purprice=0.00,
	BonusRatio=SPACE(20),
	retailprice=0.00
FROM saleledger  
WHERE saleledger.saleinvcode = :ar_invcode
